objective: Compile cinematic intent to explicitly supported conditioning
deviations: Intent (yamakan.shot-intent v1) lowers by a fixed table to the engine contract v2's own named controls and input roles; enums are lowercase snake case as the contract's control values are written

An end frame becomes the contract's lastFrame role as an AssetRef of a PNG or JPEG still of the given project; depth and pose have no contract role, so they are always unsupported (refused unless accepted as dropped, which is recorded)

The output is validated with the contract's exported ControlsSchema; tests build a full EngineRequestV2 from every intent value and check it with EngineRequestV2Schema and refusal(), so contract drift fails CI
loweredControlsHash is computed over {compiler, recipeHash, controls, inputs}
This build's server recipes (the fake engine's) declare no style controls, so every style field is reported as previs metadata, never as applied

tests.result: 5/5: contract-valid request and refusal() null; every enum value; the hash bound to the compiler and recipe; dropped and foreign guides refused; the command resolves only the project's media

reviews.judge: Sonnet subagent (same vendor; not a human)

findings.finalRound: no must-fix, no should-fix; one nit applied in 4a48754
